verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is about GAIA, AMD's open-source agent framework. It runs locally by default, keeps data private, and supports air-gapped deployment, so users can avoid sending data out. There is no documented telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for the Ryzen AI Software stack, drivers, or tools. Missing for 10: an explicit telemetry opt-out control or setting, documentation of what usage data the Ryzen AI Software, drivers, or Lemonade collect, and independent confirmation of no-telemetry operation.
